Joining the bridge. Quick technical notes from infra: we’re seeing increased OOM-related evictions on host pool a-prod-usw2-3, which is cascading into rejection (503). Immediate options:
- Roll traffic to warm standby pool in us-east-1 (low risk, short latency bump).
- Roll back to 1.2.3 model variant (older sharded checkpoint) for requests > 2k tokens.
- Increase container memory and scale pool by 2 nodes (takes ~7–12m).

I’ve executed a limited canary rollback for 2% of traffic and verified success on the canary. Commands sent to infra are attached (canary-rollback-commands.txt). If CS wants a clean customer-facing explanation, frame mitigations as: temporary routing + model fallback while we stabilize host pool.

Sean
